facts.fact: At ch 27 the Meadow Cairn bond is about two weeks old; Ila has studied Kunal's habits every day since the Meadow Cairn (consistent with F713, day ten at ch 17).
Ila and Kunal's rope is undyed wool (F436), not grey; Raghu's pairs use grey wool. Ch 27 corrects the rope colour from 'grey' to undyed.
Kunal turns back at about fifteen spans, short of the sixteen-span point (twice the rope's length) where the path vanishes; Ila counts him out span by span.
